_comment: Drop the relevant pnp entry into the mcpServers object of your Claude Desktop config. Path: macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json — Windows %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json. Restart Claude Desktop after editing.

pnp-via-npx._comment: Same effect, no global install needed.

pnp-unsafe._comment: DANGEROUS: skips the destructive-command gate. Only for fully-automated trusted pipelines. Treat like rm -rf /.

pnp-with-pnp-managed-identity._comment: Pre-set ManagedIdentity client id so pnp_auth_connect_managed_identity picks the right user-assigned MI. Only useful when running on an Azure VM / App Service.
